title: Lifecycle action focus restoration

focusedTest.command: npm test -- --run app/components/ResearchPages.test.tsx -t "organizes research records with current, archived and trash views"

behavior: Archive/restore returns focus to the originating action when the row remains visible.
When a lifecycle action removes the row from the active filter, focus returns to the status filter control.
A polite status announcement reports the completed lifecycle action.
